lines: and why does every app you build with AI have one?
Open any app, and you only see the front: buttons, text, pictures.
That's the frontend. It runs on your phone.
Tap order, and the real work happens somewhere else.
Your tap travels to a server you never see.
That hidden part is the backend.
saves your order in a database,
Then it sends an answer back, in about a second.
The frontend is the shop window. The backend is the kitchen.
If you're building with AI, ask Claude:
keep secrets and payments on the backend, never in the frontend.

claims.claim: Server-side code stores and retrieves data and controls who can access it; the browser shows the client-side front end
